reasons: Judged only from the seven images against the BUILD REQUEST (medieval stone watchtower with a wooden roof, 16x16x16) and the brief. Note: the images are byte-identical in three groups (A, B, C); (D, E); (F, G). Within a group the letter choice is arbitrary, so the ranking is by visual design. 1st F: the only set with view labels (Front, from south-east / Back, from north-west), so the door side, path and lanterns can be checked; block-level voxel detail shows the stone courses, four-window layout, two-storey massing and the stepped spruce roof with eave overhang; clean background with no stray guide lines. The crop confirms the dirt path runs out from the front wall with a lantern on each side, as the brief specifies. 2nd A: a smooth-shaded render with the clearest overall silhouette and the most polished look (even lighting, clear roof steps, legible glass panes and bands), but it has no labels and shows less block detail, so the brief's cell-level features are harder to verify. 3rd D: the same voxel geometry as F without view labels, and the black isometric guide lines run across the walls and roof, which adds clutter. Excluded from the top three: nothing in the images contradicts the brief in an obvious way, so the ranking rests on presentation and legibility rather than a geometry error.
